about: Captions for note-to-change-2026-11-16. Start times are in seconds and differ slightly between the wide and tall cuts.

wide.text: Someone in the office asks for a change from inside the app.
They type what they need: a way to see one supplier's orders at a time.
The note reaches us with the page they were on.
We build it, test it and ship it. This one took 31 minutes.
The new Vendor filter is live in their app.
